name: Data Protection Act 2018 (Ireland)
description: Irish data protection law supplementing GDPR. Enforced by Data Protection Commission (DPC). Ireland is the EU regulatory home of many global tech firms, so the DPC has handled significant GDPR enforcement actions.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Irish Statute Book (irishstatutebook.ie) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Irish Statute Book (irishstatutebook.ie).
